details: Malicious package. Same actor and infrastructure as `serverless-env-helpers`: a postinstall hook runs `node postinstall.js`, which contacted `probe-worker.hugebigballs87.workers.dev` from every detonated version, the endpoint that `serverless-env-helpers` uses to receive harvested AWS, Docker and npm credentials and cloud metadata. Observed in a sandboxed install. Published 2026-05-08/09 and unpublished from npm on 2026-05-09.
